our_interpretation: Read this as an assertion of exclusive reservation, including announced capacity still under construction.
Use the reservation status on May 6, 2026. Unlike quarterly financial results, contractual reservation status can be reported contemporaneously.
The claim covers the Fairwater family of sites, rather than only one building.
Capability to support other models, intended future workloads and actual contractual allocation are distinct.
